newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Police arrest male accomplice of female Tamil Tiger rebel suicide bomber who committed suicide by swallowing cyanide when stopped at a checkpoint in Colombo last week. Police say the dead female rebel and three other female suicide bombers had planned to stage attacks in the capital.
Navy destroys two Tamil rebel boats in northern Karainagar and eastern Trincomalee, killing at least four guerrillas.
Security tightened islandwide for Independence Day celebrations after intelligence reports of Tamil rebel attacks.
National carrier Airlanka gets extra flight to Trichy in south India after agreement reached at talks between Indian and Sri Lankan aviation officials in New Delhi.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga, in Independence Day message, urges country to devote its energies in coming year to mould united, peaceful and prosperous Sri Lanka.
